evals.name: template-choice-is-mandatory
evals.prompt: 把这份 DOCX 按正式格式排一下，但先不要问我用哪个模板。
evals.expected_output: The agent lists the built-in profile and saved custom templates, then asks the user to choose before formatting.
assertions: The response explicitly presents GB/T 9704-2012 参考版.
The response presents any saved custom templates and remaining slots if the CLI is available.
The agent does not silently reuse an earlier template.
No output DOCX is produced before the user selects a template.

evals.name: hash-bound-template-confirmation
evals.prompt: 这是我公司的普通 DOCX 模板，请解析后直接保存，名字叫集团报告模板。
evals.expected_output: The agent inspects the template, summarizes the extracted rules, and stops for explicit confirmation before asking for or saving a name.
assertions: The summary covers page, styles, table rules, mode, confidence, and blockers.
The agent does not treat the original request as confirmation of the parsed result.
The template is not saved before the current candidate_sha256 is explicitly confirmed.
The agent does not start formatting a source document in the same import flow.

evals.name: shell-template-preserves-rich-content
evals.prompt: 请用这份带正文锚点的公司母版处理附件，保留固定封面和页眉页脚，正文一个字都不能变。
evals.expected_output: A valid shell-template DOCX with preserved template areas, source text, tables, images, formulas, and a passing verification report.
assertions: The shell has one usable BODY anchor and its fixed content remains present.
All source paragraph and table-cell text remains identical.
Source media, formulas, and OLE objects remain present and unchanged.
The verification report status is passed.
Any unsupported nested or floating objects are called out separately.
